{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Define sentinel value
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Create a cleaned dataset excluding rows with sentinel baseline values
cleaned_df = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != sentinel_value]

# Verify the cleaned dataset
print(f"Original dataset size: {len(trial_df)}")
print(f"Cleaned dataset size: {len(cleaned_df)}")
print(f"Rows removed: {len(trial_df) - len(cleaned_df)}")

# Check if any biomarker_final values are sentinel
print(f"Any sentinel values in biomarker_final after cleaning? {cleaned_df['biomarker_final'].eq(sentinel_value).any()}")"}
